title: Asynchronous Verifiable Consensus for Heterogeneous Research Swarms: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Decentralized swarms of autonomous agents require Byzantine fault tolerance without expensive synchronous barrier synchronization. We formulate an asynchronous directed acyclic graph (DAG) consensus protocol for multi-agent hypothesis exploration. On clusters of 128 autonomous agents, our protocol reaches state finality in 1.12 seconds with zero deadlocks under 25% network packet loss. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 2.8x and a verified task accuracy of 97.4% with mean execution latency of 1.12ms.
